verdict.rationale: FutureHouse/Edison is an API-driven agent platform, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair axis. However, the evidence only documents submitting tasks and then polling or blocking for results (create_task/get_task, run_tasks_until_done, querying results later). Nothing in the pack shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for task or other events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
